season.evidence: Web: Forest Service lists summer-fall; Mountaineers lists July-October; guidebook pages say steep snow lingers into August and most go August-October, lookout locked November-May. Peak logs peak Sep (100). Stored Jul-Oct kept.

track.why: Only route on the peak; logged Winchester Mountain Trail, 13 Oct 2024, round trip 182 m from our trailhead pin, ends within 1 m of the lookout summit, about 3.6 mi and 1,470 ft.

otherTracksConsidered.why: Sept 2026 outing whose highest point is on a neighbouring summit (Yellow Aster area); a combined trip.
Oct 2025 ascent, track stops at the summit (not a round trip).

facts.text: In mid-October snow and ice can sit on the upper trail near the top even when the road below is bare.
In mid-October two cross-ditches at the very end of the road kept a low-slung car from reaching the lot, so a short extra road walk may be needed.
At the start of November about a foot of loose new snow can cover the trail above roughly 6,000 ft, with the road iced from the switchbacks, so the climb becomes a trail-breaking slog.

notes: Pin 0.18 km off the track start is within tolerance; no move proposed.
